name: example

cms._help: dryrun = report only (default). nextjs = edit repo + open PR. wordpress = WP REST API.

gsc._help: Set enabled:true once you have a service-account JSON at GSC_CREDENTIALS and have added it as a GSC user.

promptPanel: how much does Botox cost in {city}
_help_domains: All owned domains/subdomains for this brand — drives the cross-domain entity graph + portfolio rollup.

edge._help: none | vercel (Edge Config/middleware overlay on infra WE own) | cloudflare-worker (HTMLRewriter for clients not on our edge — graduates to source PR). Server-rendered, content-PARITY only; never cloaking.

dns._help: Reads/writes zone records via connect/cloudflare.mjs. Trust/verification/deliverability lever (not a ranking factor): CAA, SPF/DKIM/DMARC/BIMI/MTA-STS, verification TXT, IndexNow key. All writes gated behind --yes.

_help_aiPolicy: allow | index-only (allow OAI-SearchBot/PerplexityBot/Googlebot, block GPTBot/CCBot/Bytespider training) | block-training. Drives robots.txt + edge bot handling.

riskTiers._help: Pages matching highRiskPathRe ALWAYS queue for human review (never auto-apply); legal-sensitive med-spa rules never auto-apply regardless.

logs._help: Server/edge access-log source for crawl intelligence (crawl-budget + crawl-to-cite). OTTO has no equivalent.
